Implemented non-overlapping Dot song-info overlay on Linux.

### What changed
- **`lib/widgets/heroes/dot_hero.dart`**
  - When `DotScreenConfig.showSongInfo == true`, the pulsing dot’s **maximum radius is reduced** based on the worst-case height of the `HeroTitleBlock` (so long artist/title at normal + max hero text sizes won’t intersect the centered dot).
  - Persistence/default behavior is unchanged: **`DotScreenConfig.showSongInfo` remains default-off (`false`)**.

### Screenshots (390x844 phone frame)
- Normal text size (Dot `textScale: 1.0`):
  - `/.tmp/agent_shots/dot_songinfo_text_normal.png`
- Maximum text size (Dot `textScale: 1.5`):
  - `/.tmp/agent_shots/dot_songinfo_text_max.png`

No Flutter overflow reports were emitted for these runs.
